outcome: Child profiles are a policy and presentation facade over the parent's execution session. They use the common launch, retained switch, retry, recovery, close and hard-reset paths. Gateway child sessions attach time to that shared session; Playnite Bridge has no child provider lifecycle. Terminal child policy continues the same fenced common cleanup until game and stream completion are definitive.
changes: Heartbeat and housekeeping retry cleanup_required before current-game expiry classification, preserving the original terminal operation, generation, actor lease epoch and exact identities.
Ambiguous actor/time handoff after an attachment mutation fails closed through common whole-session termination.
Allowed running games are adopted without provider restart; retained switches and parent-child-child handoffs preserve one execution session.
Parent-child and child-child handoffs commit the stream actor, control generation, actor epoch and child-time attachment atomically; policy failure keeps the previous actor metered.
Child suspend is fenced to the exact session, stream generation and actor epoch through effect scheduling and time release, preventing a stale actor from suspending a newer handoff.
All touched game-stop paths, including retained switch, End Game and transition cancellation, require the observed exact process token; terminal retry retires only the old process identity.
Provider-start compensation binds the first exact observed process token to its provider owner, carries it through owner transfer and rejects a later same-game process with a different token.
The child API rejects legacy game/stop and exposes only the common exact game/stop-verified action for provider termination.
Housekeeping closes the exact shared stream when a running child attachment observes a replacement process; a complete scan retires old token A without stopping replacement B.
A disallowed active game is never a child tile and selecting an allowed game performs common full close without confirmation before launch.
Removed Playnite Bridge child bind, renew, end, lease persistence, endpoint and enforcer; normal lifecycle never calls provider /child/session.
Child install, uninstall, sleep, stream settings, calibration and VirtualHere use common parent mechanisms; Discord, microphone and child-management remain unavailable.
